alex (FP&A): @here Quick update — we rolled out a refresh to P-Card spend categories and the vendor approval thresholds this morning. Please read and follow the new mapping and approval steps when submitting expenses or vendor requests.

linda (Finance Manager): TL;DR — receipts still required within 3 business days, Ramp card usage unchanged, but category selection and approval path changed for mid/high-dollar items.

jenny (Eng PM): Thanks. Any change to project-level cards? We use those for infra credits.

alex (FP&A): Project cards: default monthly cap raised to $10,000 (was $7k) with manager pre-approval. Individual cards: default $3,000/month. For anything >$10k use the vendor approval flow.

maria (People Ops): Does this affect recruiting/contractor spend categories?

linda (Finance Manager): Yes — recruiting vendor invoices should use the new "Talent Services" category. If it's a one-off contractor card charge, tag it as "Contractor Expense" and attach SOW or invoice.

alex (FP&A): New auto-approval thresholds (summary):
```
- < $2,000: auto-approve (manager + expense report)
- $2,000 — $10,000: manager approval required (submit via procurement form)
- > $10,000: procurement review + finance sign-off
```

alex (FP&A): New category mapping examples (use these exact strings in Ramp/expense tool):
```
Cloud Infra -> Cloud Services
SaaS Tools -> Software & Subscriptions
Team Meals -> Employee Meals
Recruiting Fees -> Talent Services
Hardware -> Capital Equipment
```

jenny (Eng PM): Where do we submit the procurement form? Link?

linda (Finance Manager): Confluence page + vendor onboarding form: https://confluence.redwood.ai/finance/vendor-requests (use the green "Submit Vendor" button). For existing vendors, use the vendor-change form.

procurement-bot: New vendor request template is live. Add vendor docs to the ticket. Reminder: W-9 or equivalent required for US vendors.

jenny (Eng PM): If we have recurring cloud spend with a new vendor, do we need a PO?

alex (FP&A): Recurring subscriptions < $10k/month — no PO required, but please add to the subscription tracker and tag the project owner. Anything recurring >= $10k/month needs a PO + procurement review.

maria (People Ops): Exceptions for urgent hires? We can request expedited review?

linda (Finance Manager): Yes — use the "expedite" checkbox on the vendor form and add justification. Procurement will triage within 48 hours for expedite requests.

alex (FP&A): Quick checklist when charging P-Card: 1) correct category string, 2) attach receipt/invoice, 3) add project tag, 4) if over threshold start vendor flow.

jenny (Eng PM): Noted. Can procurement add the new categories to Ramp so it's easier to pick?

procurement-bot: Ramp categories updated: Cloud Services, Software & Subscriptions, Employee Meals, Talent Services, Capital Equipment.

alex (FP&A): We'll run a short audit next week on category usage for March to catch miscategorizations. If you see anything odd, DM me or @linda.

linda (Finance Manager): FYI — receipts not provided within 3 business days will trigger an automated hold and a reconciliation email from finance. Avoid holds by uploading on time. :calendar:

maria (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll update the hiring doc with the new Talent Services wording.

jenny (Eng PM): Appreciate it — sending to my team now.

alex (FP&A): Closing note: if you're unsure where something belongs, pick the closest category and add a short comment on the expense. We'll reach out if reclass is needed. Thanks! :thumbsup:
